ctx.x: So one time we went to sing a little further(?)... Miss Fanella gave a concert. And that was out of Pollard's Land then, you know. And when I got out on the stage and I saw all these strange people, I got kind of cold feet. So a girl named Woods, she said, "Well, if I go stand on the stage with you, would you sing?" I said, "Yes." So she just stood up there whilst I sang my song, you know. And the next time they had a concert, well, I wasn't ashamed.

So I sang until I was about eleven years old. Not about; I know I was eleven years old. So my mother said to me, "If anybody asks you to be in a concert, tell them you know how to dance. Don't tell them you know how to sing." So I said, "Why?" She said, "Because those songs that you're singing, people think you know what you're saying." I said, "Well, what's wrong with them songs, Mama." She said, "Well, never mind what's wrong with them. They are not for a little girl to sing." She said, "But you tell them that…
